description.sl: Glagoli, ki jih dedek Bepi rabi v vsaki zgodbi: zgoditi se, odločiti se, zdeti se, uspeti, iskati, izbrati, spremeniti, upati, verjeti, opaziti, manjkati, zadostovati, začeti, nadaljevati, nehati, pustiti, poznati, vprašati.
description.en: The verbs Nonno Bepi uses in every story: to happen, to decide, to seem, to manage, to look for, to choose, to change, to hope, to believe, to notice, to be missing, to be enough, to begin, to go on, to stop, to leave, to know someone, to ask.
description.de: Die Verben, die Nonno Bepi in jeder Geschichte braucht: passieren, entscheiden, scheinen, schaffen, suchen, wählen, ändern, hoffen, glauben, bemerken, fehlen, genügen, anfangen, weitermachen, aufhören, lassen, kennen, fragen.

review: it, sl, en, de: machine-written (Claude), not reviewed by a native speaker

words.example_en: What happened?
words.example_de: Was ist passiert?

words.example_en: Have you decided which ice cream you want?
words.example_de: Hast du dich entschieden, welches Eis du willst?

words.example_en: The dog seems tired.
words.example_de: Der Hund scheint müde zu sein.
words.note: Mi sembra di sì: I think so.
words.note_sl: Mi sembra di sì: zdi se mi, da ja.
words.note_de: Mi sembra di sì: Ich glaube schon.

words.example_en: I managed to climb the tree!
words.example_de: Ich habe es geschafft, auf den Baum zu klettern!
words.note: Like uscire: riesco, riesci, riesce. Past with essere.
words.note_sl: Kot uscire: riesco, riesci, riesce. Preteklik z essere.
words.note_de: Wie uscire: riesco, riesci, riesce. Vergangenheit mit essere.

words.example_en: I'm looking everywhere for my exercise book.
words.example_de: Ich suche mein Heft überall.
words.note: Cercare di: to try to. Cerco di dormire: I'm trying to sleep.
words.note_sl: Cercare di: poskušati. Cerco di dormire: poskušam zaspati.
words.note_de: Cercare di: versuchen. Cerco di dormire: Ich versuche zu schlafen.

words.example_it: Scegli un libro, poi lo leggiamo insieme.
words.example_sl: Izberi knjigo, potem jo bova skupaj prebrala.
words.example_en: Choose a book, then we'll read it together.
words.example_de: Such dir ein Buch aus, dann lesen wir es zusammen.
words.note: Io scelgo, tu scegli; past: ho scelto.
words.note_sl: Io scelgo, tu scegli; preteklik: ho scelto.
words.note_de: Io scelgo, tu scegli; Vergangenheit: ho scelto.

words.example_it: Il tempo cambia in fretta in montagna.
words.example_sl: Vreme se v gorah hitro spremeni.
words.example_en: The weather changes fast in the mountains.
words.example_de: In den Bergen ändert sich das Wetter schnell.

words.example_it: Spero che domani ci sia il sole.
words.example_en: I hope it's sunny tomorrow.
words.example_de: Ich hoffe, morgen scheint die Sonne.
words.note: Spero di sì: I hope so.
words.note_sl: Spero di sì: upam, da ja.
words.note_de: Spero di sì: Ich hoffe es.

words.example_it: Non ci credo: hai trovato un tesoro?
words.example_en: I don't believe it: you've found a treasure?
words.example_de: Ich glaube es nicht: Du hast einen Schatz gefunden?

words.example_it: Non mi sono accorto che pioveva.
words.example_en: I didn't notice it was raining.
words.example_de: Ich habe nicht bemerkt, dass es regnete.
words.note: Past with essere: mi sono accorto, mi sono accorta.
words.note_sl: Preteklik z essere: mi sono accorto, mi sono accorta.
words.note_de: Vergangenheit mit essere: mi sono accorto, mi sono accorta.

words.example_en: A piece of the jigsaw is missing!
words.example_de: Ein Puzzleteil fehlt!
words.note: Mi manchi: I miss you (you are missing to me).

words.example_en: That's enough, thank you!
words.example_de: Das reicht, danke!

words.example_en: School starts in September.
words.example_de: Die Schule fängt im September an.

words.example_en: Keep reading, it's lovely!
words.example_de: Lies weiter, es ist wunderschön!

words.example_en: It has stopped raining.
words.example_de: Es hat aufgehört zu regnen.
words.note: Smettere di fare: to stop doing. Like mettere: ho smesso.
words.note_sl: Smettere di fare: nehati delati. Kot mettere: ho smesso.
words.note_de: Smettere di fare: aufhören zu tun. Wie mettere: ho smesso.

words.example_it: Lascia la porta aperta, per favore.
words.example_en: Leave the door open, please.
words.example_de: Lass bitte die Tür offen.

words.example_en: Do you know the new teacher?
words.example_de: Kennst du die neue Lehrerin?
words.note: Sapere is knowing a fact; conoscere is knowing someone or a place.
words.note_sl: Sapere je vedeti nekaj; conoscere je poznati nekoga ali kraj.
words.note_de: Sapere heißt etwas wissen; conoscere heißt jemanden oder einen Ort kennen.

words.en: to ask a question, to ask for
words.example_it: Chiedi alla nonna se possiamo uscire.
words.example_sl: Vprašaj babico, če lahko gremo ven.
words.example_en: Ask Granny if we can go out.
words.example_de: Frag Oma, ob wir rausgehen dürfen.

words.en: to turn out, to come up
words.example_sl: Vsakemu se pripeti, da se zmoti.
words.example_en: It happens to everyone to make a mistake.
words.example_de: Es kommt bei jedem vor, dass er sich irrt.

words.example_en: Do you need a hand?
words.example_de: Brauchst du Hilfe?
words.note: The thing needed comes first: mi serve una penna, I need a pen.
words.note_sl: Potrebna stvar je osebek: mi serve una penna, potrebujem pisalo.
words.note_de: Das Gebrauchte ist das Subjekt: mi serve una penna, ich brauche einen Stift.
